metadata.title: FloodWave-At raw data: twelve widefield GCaMP time-lapses of Arabidopsis thaliana rosettes during root flooding (Zeiss .czi, 10 January 2020) and the 2020 Fiji videos
metadata.description: Twelve single-channel time-lapse recordings (Zeiss ZEN .czi, 692 × 520 px, 20.49 µm per pixel, GFP filter set 38 HE, a median 1.212 s per frame, 198–1140 frames) made on 10 January 2020 on a Zeiss Axio Zoom.V16. In each run the roots of a GCaMP-expressing Arabidopsis thaliana rosette were flooded with water from below while the rosette was imaged from above. Also included are five Fiji video exports made from run 8 in April 2020; their burned-in clocks assume 1 s per frame (true interval 1.212 s), and they start 48.5 s into the recording. Per-file metadata, checksums, analysis code and results are in the FloodWave-At repository.
metadata.notes: GCaMP construct not yet confirmed. The 2020 'Flood Wave' slide deck is not part of this deposit until the rights to its third-party figures are settled.
